original_text: <!-- (Audio) Expert: Absolutely. My first suggestion is to not hit the snooze button multiple times. It may be tempting, but it disrupts your sleep cycle and you may feel groggy during the day. -->
translated_text: <!-- (Audio) Expert: Apsolutno. Moj prvi savet je da ne pritiskate dugme za odlaganje više puta. Može biti privlačno, ali poremećuje vaš ciklus spavanja i tokom dana se možete osećati pospano/zamagljeno. -->
